Nothing in the documents covers an outbox verb, and the code has none. I read `engine-cli.spec.md` lines 14-163, the guide's "Hold filing" section, `improve/filing.py` lines 300-514 and the `cli/` parser registrations. I ran no tests.

ARTIFACT gap_finding: Searched `docs/` and `engine/src` for "outbox". No verb lists or clears the filing outbox, and no document states one. `engine-cli.spec.md` CLI-B7 (line 55) lists the exact accepted verbs, with no outbox verb. A new verb needs a CLI-B7 edit, since any other first word exits 2. `main.py:34-35` holds the matching `VERBS` tuple. CLI-B14 (line 100) is the pattern for a verb owned by another spec, linked by behaviour ids. CLI-B8 (line 61) lists the read-only verbs, so a list verb belongs there. `stats` is the model for mixed verbs: `stats forget` is a mutating sub-verb, excepted in CLI-B8. CLI-B16 requires a mutating verb to record its caller. The guide's "Hold filing" (`improving-workflows.guide.md:15-30`) never mentions the outbox. The spec-side outbox text is SIL-B19 (`self-improvement.spec.md:164-166`) and LOS-B7 (`local-observability-store.spec.md:11`), which says `filing-outbox.jsonl` holds "issue payloads a code host refused". In code, `Outbox` (`improve/filing.py:340-360`) is `{state root}/filing-outbox.jsonl` with `add` (append a JSON line) and `take` (read all lines, then delete the file). There is no list, no remove-by-fingerprint and no clear. Payloads (`filing.py:496-500`, `:449-513`) have `op` (comment/create/reopen), `repo`, `number` or `title`, `body`, `labels` and `fingerprint` (the first of the group). They have no timestamp, so "age" and `outbox.max_age_days` need a stored enqueue time. Reopen payloads come from `release.py` and carry `repo` and `number`. CLI parsers are in `cli/improve.py` (`add_parsers` at line 22, which also registers `improve` and its sub-verbs at lines 90-115) and in `cli/main.py`. `engine-cli.spec.md` has about 163 lines, so the 400-line spec budget is not near.
